summary.zh: SOXX盘前约-2.5%（8:18），纳指期货约-1.3%：谷歌财报不及预期、盘后跌约10%，重燃市场对AI投入回报的担忧；Marvell传出收购Lumentum而暴跌约12%，英特尔、美光、博通均跌约3%。缺口预计约-2.4%。昨日SOX已涨1.75%，欧洲半导体基本持平，Marvell拖累属个股因素，开盘后略有回补，约+0.2%，全天约-2.2%。
summary.en: SOXX was about -2.5% pre-market (8:18 ET) with Nasdaq futures -1.3%: Alphabet's earnings miss (shares down ~10% after hours) revived doubts on AI spending returns, and Marvell fell ~12% on Lumentum deal talk. Intel, Micron and Broadcom are down ~3%. I expect a gap near -2.4% and a small +0.2% recovery after the open, since Europe's chips are flat and Marvell is stock-specific.

factors.zh: 谷歌财报不及预期，盘后约-10%，纳指期货约-1.3%，AI投入回报担忧
factors.en: Alphabet earnings miss, ~-10% after hours; Nasdaq futures ~-1.3%, AI-spending return doubts
Marvell about -12% pre-market on Lumentum acquisition talk
Broad weakness: MU -2.8%, AVGO -2.7%, AMD -2.4%, INTC -3.4%; Samsung -4.1%

factors.zh: 英伟达仅-0.6%，KLA +2.2%，Advantest +6%，欧洲半导体基本持平
factors.en: NVDA only -0.6%, KLA +2.2%, Advantest +6%, Europe's chips flat

factors.zh: 模型开盘后值-0.2%；缺口-1.5%至-3%区间开盘后平均约0；10年期收益率约5.05%
factors.en: Model after-open value -0.2%; base rate for this gap size is ~0 after the open; 10-year yield ~5.05%

risk.zh: 若谷歌拖累扩散到英伟达等龙头并持续抛售，跌幅会超过-3%；若逢低买盘强劲，收盘可能收窄至-1%以内。
risk.en: If the Alphabet selloff spreads to leaders like Nvidia and sells through the day, the drop exceeds -3%; strong dip-buying could narrow it to better than -1%.

views.en: Weak Alphabet and Samsung results have renewed doubts about the returns on AI spending.
views.zh: 德意志银行称，谷歌和三星业绩不及预期，重新引发市场对AI投入回报的质疑。

views.en: Argued that the AI boom itself is weighing on Google's traditional advertising business, a sign of disruption inside the AI trade.
views.zh: VanEck的Jamie Hannah认为，AI热潮本身正冲击谷歌传统广告业务。
